final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank/missing)') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '(blank/missing)')), shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM hand_counts) SELECT hand, tally, share, share - average_share AS excess_share FROM shares WHERE share > average_share ORDER BY hand
